blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Official DebtToken source restricts only fixed invalid recipient sinks and protocol burn callers; no arbitrary holder denylist was found there. Live transparent-proxy upgradeability and Safe control can replace this logic, so an unconditional no-freeze verdict is unsupported; exact runtime equivalence remains unproved.

oracleRisk.summary: RedStone FIL/USD is primary, with Tellor fallback updated by a Secured Finance-operated job roughly every12hours; fallback is not independent and cached prices persist up to48hours.

branchApplicability.rationale: The single FIL Trove market has liquidation thresholds, Stability Pool, redistribution and oracle failure behavior that require one collateral branch.

branches.label: Filecoin FIL Troves
branches.summary: One FIL market uses RedStone with operator-submitted Tellor fallback and last-good-price caching.

feeds.path: FIL/USD -> PriceFeed -> FIL Trove collateral ratios

branches.fallbackBehavior: Primary timeout16hours; failed or invalid calls or doubled/halved prices cause fallback. If both feeds fail, last-good-price may persist48hours; beyond that price-sensitive operations revert.

collateralParameters.note: Recovery Mode begins below150% system collateralization; minimum Trove debt200USDFC.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless Trove liquidation first offsets debt with Stability Pool deposits, then redistributes uncovered debt and collateral among active Troves.
branches.backstop: Funded Stability Pool with redistribution to surviving FIL Troves; deposits are variable.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Recovery Mode tightens borrowing below150% system ratio. Oracle outage eventually halts price-sensitive operations; an emergency shutdown or loss-recovery guarantee is not established.
